title: Similar Based Extensions
body_html:
Similar Based Extensions

For a based extension $(E,\beta)$ with $\beta\ne 0$, write $y_\beta$ for the image of

$$ \varpi_F^{n/g}\beta^{e/g} $$

in the residue field $k_E$, where

$$ e=e(E/F), \qquad n=-\operatorname{val}_E(\beta), \qquad g=\gcd(n,e). $$

Set $y_0=0$ in $k_F$.

Two based extensions $(E,\beta)$ and $(E',\beta')$ of $F$ are similar if:

  1. $f(E/F)=f(E'/F)$ and $e(E/F)=e(E'/F)$;
  2. $\operatorname{val}_E(\beta)=\operatorname{val}_{E'}(\beta')$;
  3. there is a $k_F$-linear field isomorphism $k_E\simeq k_{E'}$ sending $y_\beta$ to $y_{\beta'}$.

The draft states that this notion is independent of the chosen uniformizer $\varpi_F$.

If two ps-characters are endo-equivalent and supported on $\beta$ and $\beta'$, then $(F[\beta],\beta)$ and $(F[\beta'],\beta')$ are similar. Hence an endo-class has a well-defined degree.
